text: Given a valid subscription_id, quantity, and a valid Pax8 credential, when pax8_update_subscription is called, then it sends PUT /subscriptions/{subscription_id} and returns the updated subscription JSON (id, quantity, status, billingTerm present).

Given only subscription_id and quantity are passed, when pax8_update_subscription is called, then the outbound PUT body contains exactly {"quantity": ...} with no null keys for the omitted optional fields.
Given no Pax8 credential is available, when pax8_update_subscription is called, then it returns the existing _NO_TOKEN message and makes zero HTTP calls.
Given the Pax8 API returns a 4xx or 5xx response, when pax8_update_subscription is called, then it returns "Error {status_code}: {message}" and never raises an unhandled exception.
Given two concurrent calls to pax8_update_subscription carrying two different tenants' credentials, when both run at the same time, then each call's outbound Pax8 request carries only its own token.
The README documents the new tool consistent with the other 9 tools.
steps: Open README.md on the work branch
expect: A pax8_update_subscription row exists in the Tool List table with description and key parameters, in the same shape as the other 9 rows; Parameter Details documents the billingTerm enum (Monthly, Annual, 2-Year, 3-Year, 1-Time, Trial).
